inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, consolidated cash flow statement equity-settled share award expense RMB90.2m (H1 FY2026: RMB28.9m); EquityAwardTaxes nil in every period (kpis). Not stripped of interest income: the group is net debt (RMB26.9bn), so FY2025 interest income of RMB93.6m stays in the flows and no cash pile is added to EV.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in CNY (RMB); HKEX H-share quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNY/HKD 1.1727 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T16:48Z): 1 CNY = 1.1727 HKD, so model -> quote multiplies. Dual-listing cross-check: A-share 002460.SZ closed CNY 39.29 on 2026-10-16 = HKD 46.08 at this rate, against the H-share close at inputs.price_as_of -- an A/H premium of ~92% (H at a ~48% discount). The A/H lines do not arbitrage, so the check confirms the rate direction and quote basis, not price parity; Ganfeng's A/H premium has historically run 50-100%, so the gap is within its own range.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,096,694,404 issued shares at 30 Sep 2026 (1,613,593,699 A + 483,100,705 H, Q3 FY2026 report and H1 FY2026 interim) plus ~40,689,040 H shares underlying the outstanding convertible bonds (H1 FY2026 interim) = 2,137.4m fully diluted. Treasury shares (RMB856m held for employee share incentives) are NOT netted off because they are destined for award; the convertible is counted in the share count AND left inside total debt (RMB943m bonds payable), a deliberate small double-count on the conservative side (~RMB0.4/share). Held FLAT: SBC (0.3% of revenue) is expensed in the flows; no non-SBC issuance is modelled. The 2026 repurchases (treasury shares +RMB412m over 9M) fund the flat count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Cost of equity 12.3% = China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.4 x ERP 7.5% (China ~6% plus ~1.5pp for H-share governance and Argentina/Mali jurisdiction exposure). After-tax cost of debt ~3.0% (RMB bank borrowings and bonds at ~3.5-4% pre-tax; FY2025 finance costs RMB1,474m on ~RMB35bn of debt = 4.2%). Target capital structure 65/35 equity/debt (the current ~45% debt weight at a trough share price is itself a cycle artefact and the company is deleveraging as capex falls). WACC = 0.65 x 12.3% + 0.35 x 3.0% = 9.0%. Applied identically to all three scenarios: lithium-price cyclicality is charged ONCE, in the scenario paths and weights, not as a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt, but immaterial: lease liabilities RMB28.5m at 30 Sep 2026 (right-of-use assets RMB92m) against RMB36.9bn of borrowings. Excluded from net debt and from the flows as a rounding item; no lease_cost_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests of RMB7,106.7m at 30 Sep 2026 (Q3 FY2026 balance sheet) deducted at book value. Flows are modelled on the consolidated basis (the NCI's profit share swings sign: +RMB175m H1 FY2026, -RMB350m FY2025), so folding it into a leakage rate would be unstable. NCI sits mainly in the Mali (Goulamina) and Argentine project subsidiaries.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, non-US, highly cyclical commodity producer) per dcf-methods routing; owner-fcf.md and owner-fcf-adaptations.md both applied. First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. CYCLE FRAMING: Ganfeng is an integrated lithium chemicals producer (carbonate/hydroxide/metal) with upstream resources (Goulamina Mali, Cauchari-Olaroz and Mariana Argentina, Mt Marion offtake) and a battery/energy-storage segment. Gross margin ran 49% at the FY2022 price peak, 14%/11% in FY2023/FY2024, 16% in FY2025, 31% in H1 FY2026 on a lithium-price spike and ~21% in Q3 FY2026 as prices rolled over; the H-share has fallen from HKD91 to HKD24 within the year. FY0 is set to FY2026E revenue of RMB46.5bn (9M actual RMB36.2bn per the Q3 FY2026 report plus a Q4 estimate of ~RMB10.3bn on the weaker Q3 exit price) so that the 30 Sep 2026 balance sheet and the forecast years line up without double-counting 9M FY2026 cash flows (9M FY2026 FCF was ~+RMB0.25bn, immaterial). Year 1 of the forecast is FY2027 and is a deliberate MEAN REVERSION, not a run-rate: base revenue -25% to ~RMB35bn (mid-cycle carbonate ~RMB100-120k/t on ~180-190kt LCE plus ~RMB12bn of battery sales), base EBITDA margin 22% against 14% at the FY2025 trough, ~25% for 9M FY2026 and ~47% at the FY2022 peak. Growth thereafter is volume-led (Goulamina phase 2, Mariana, Cauchari-Olaroz, energy-storage batteries) and decelerates to 2.5%. Working-capital capture is NEGATIVE (-15% of the revenue change): receivables + inventory of ~RMB25bn against payables of ~RMB18bn, so growth consumes cash and the FY2027 price-led revenue decline releases some. Capex ramps down from RMB7.3bn (FY2025) toward D&A as the build-out completes (H1 FY2026 capex only RMB1.8bn). Cash tax 25% blended (PRC 15% HNTE parent, 25% subsidiaries, Argentina 35%; H1 FY2026 effective 28.5%). last_fcf / reported_fcf are the FY2025 AUDITED figures (the last full year): OCF RMB2,945m less capex RMB7,271m = -RMB4,326m reported, -RMB4,416m owner; the trailing twelve months to Sep 2026 are roughly +RMB1.8bn. BRIDGE: the EBITDA build on revenue excludes share of JV/associate profits (Minera Exar JV etc.), investment income and fair-value gains on the PLS and other listed stakes, so the source assets are added at the latest carrying values and NCI is deducted (see equity_bridge). TERMINAL: 12x FCF cap for a cyclical (Gordon at 9%/2.5% would be 15.8x). The bear case is a solvency path: net debt of RMB26.9bn against mid-cycle EBITDA of ~RMB4bn on a sustained ~RMB80k/t price; see the bear narrative.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle volume growth (Goulamina/Mariana/Cauchari ramp, energy-storage batteries) after the FY2027 price mean-reversion; every historical CAGR here is a lithium-price artefact (FY2022 peak to FY2025 trough)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR +0.8% vs revenue -18.0% and EPS -57.2%; 5yr equity +33.4% vs revenue +32.9% and EPS +0.3%. All driven by the FY2022 lithium-price peak sitting inside the 3yr window and the FY2020 trough at the start of the 5yr window; none is a usable forward rate.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF less SBC; interest income not stripped as the group is net debt): FY2020 -485, FY2021 -1,037, FY2022 +7,217, FY2023 -8,723, FY2024 -3,867, FY2025 -4,416 (RMB m). Negative at both ends of the 3yr and 5yr windows, so FCF CAGRs are undefined. The company has burned ~RMB17bn of owner FCF over FY2023-FY2025 funding mine and plant construction, financed by RMB22bn of added debt (RMB12.8bn FY2022 to RMB35.1bn FY2025). SBC is immaterial (0.1-0.4% of revenue), so owner and reported FCF track each other.

base.narrative: FY2027 revenue mean-reverts 25% from the FY2026E spike year to ~RMB35bn (mid-cycle lithium ~RMB100-120k/t, ~185kt LCE, battery segment ~RMB12bn); EBITDA margin 22% throughout (between the 14% FY2025 trough and the ~25% 9M FY2026 level, reflecting rising self-supplied resource share); capex glides from 11.5% to the 8.5% D&A level by year 7 as the build-out completes; 25% cash tax; WC consumes 15% of each year's revenue increase.

bull.narrative: Lithium holds ~RMB130-150k/t through 2027 (supply discipline, energy-storage demand) so FY2027 revenue only falls 10%; volume growth 10%/8%/7% as Goulamina phase 2, Mariana and Cauchari-Olaroz ramp at full margin; EBITDA margin 27% on a higher self-supplied resource share; same capex glide, slightly lower D&A intensity on the larger revenue base.

bear.narrative: A repeat of 2023-2025: lithium falls back to ~RMB80k/t and stays there as African spodumene and Chinese lepidolite supply overwhelms demand; FY2027 revenue -40% to ~RMB28bn (FY2025 level plus volume); EBITDA margin 14-15% (the FY2025 trough); capex cannot fall below ~D&A because the Argentine and Malian projects still need sustaining spend; terminal growth 2%. On this path FCF barely covers interest on RMB27bn of net debt and the equity is close to a solvency option.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle normalisation. The FY2026 spike (H1 gross margin 31%, Q3 21%, H-share from HKD91 to HKD24) is treated as a peak year, not a run-rate: FY2027 revenue reverts 25% to ~RMB35bn at a mid-cycle carbonate price of ~RMB100-120k/t, and growth thereafter is volume (Goulamina phase 2, Mariana brine, Cauchari-Olaroz via the Minera Exar JV, and the energy-storage battery segment), decelerating from 8% to 2.5%. EBITDA margin 22% through the cycle, above the FY2025 trough (14%) because self-supplied resources now cover a larger share of feed, below the 9M FY2026 level (~25%). Capex glides from RMB4bn toward D&A as the 2022-2025 construction programme (RMB24bn over three years) completes, which is the single biggest swing from negative to positive owner FCF. Net debt of RMB26.9bn and NCI of RMB7.1bn are deducted; RMB16.3bn of JV/associate and listed-stake investments are added back because their income is outside the EBITDA build.
scenario_narratives.bull: Lithium stays tight: supply discipline (Chinese lepidolite curtailments, slower African ramps) plus energy-storage demand hold the price at ~RMB130-150k/t, so FY2027 revenue falls only 10% and the resource ramp lands on full margins -- EBITDA 27%, volume growth 10%/8%/7%. Deleveraging is fast enough that the FCF yield re-rates the H-share toward A-share parity. Needs several things to go right at once (price, project execution in Argentina and Mali, and a stable Chinese policy backdrop), hence the lower weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: A rerun of 2023-2025. The 2026 price spike pulls in supply, carbonate falls back to ~RMB80k/t and stays there; FY2027 revenue drops 40% to ~RMB28bn and the EBITDA margin sits at the 14-15% FY2025 trough. With sustaining capex near D&A, owner FCF is a few hundred million a year against RMB27bn of net debt and RMB1.4bn of annual finance costs; the company survives on Chinese bank refinancing and asset sales (the listed stakes), but the equity carries little DCF value. This is the scenario the H-share's 74% drawdown is pricing.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: net debt/mid-cycle EBITDA ~3.5x, owner FCF negative for three of the last four years, the lithium price has rolled over again in Q3 FY2026 and the stock is at a 52-week low -- the 2023-2025 drawdown is a live template, not a tail. Bull cut to 20% because it requires sustained high prices AND clean execution of Argentine/Malian ramps simultaneously. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value an integrated lithium producer on a through-the-cycle owner-FCF basis: a mid-cycle price and margin from year 1 rather than the latest spike quarter, volume growth from projects already built, capex gliding to D&A, and a 12x terminal cap for a cyclical. Leverage, NCI and the JV/listed-stake portfolio are handled explicitly in the bridge so the equity value reflects the balance sheet the H-shareholder actually owns.
key_risks_to_valuation: Lithium price path: every 10% on the mid-cycle price is roughly RMB1bn of EBITDA; the base case's RMB100-120k/t assumption is a judgment, not an observable
Leverage: RMB36.9bn gross debt, RMB26.9bn net, against mid-cycle EBITDA of ~RMB7-8bn; refinancing depends on Chinese bank support through the trough
Project execution and jurisdiction: Goulamina (Mali, military government, new mining code), Cauchari-Olaroz and Mariana (Argentina FX controls), each consolidated with large NCI
Bridge values: RMB12.8bn of equity-accounted investments are at book; a lower lithium price impairs both them and the RMB3.5bn listed-stake portfolio
Working capital: inventory of RMB15bn at Sep 2026 is price-inflated; a price fall releases cash but also triggers write-downs that depress reported margins (FY2023 precedent)
A/H discount: the H-share trades at ~48% below the A-share; closing that gap is a re-rating thesis, not a cash-flow one
